analyst.summary: Mastek is a steady, mid-sized IT services company with UK public-sector exposure, growing revenue in the low double digits with healthy returns on capital and a deleveraging balance sheet. The stock has de-rated sharply along with the broader IT services sector on fears that AI-driven productivity gains will compress services pricing, leaving it statistically cheap at around 13x earnings despite no clear deterioration in its own operating performance. We rate this a Hold.
